title: Prompt to Material in Unity | AI Game Developer
author: BAIZOR
selftext: I made the MCP for Unity Editor with wide range of features. It is free open-source solution [AI Game Developer](https://github.com/IvanMurzak/Unity-MCP?tab=readme-ov-file#-ai-game-developer--unity-mcp).

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: Damnnn giving me hope to get into 3d game dev eventually 3d assets are so intimidating I think lol only thing thats held me back

replies.author: shlaifu
replies.body: yes. but also every single other person on the planet. ... so whether or not any of us can make money with gamedev will depend on our marketing skills... this is all going so fast...

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body:
100% agreed as with everything in the world sales and marketing has always been the leading cause in success for businesses luckily I've got a decent amount of sales experience so it has made learning marketing a bit easier but I'm personally not a fan of social media so its hard for me to sometimes to be motivated to post or even open the apps lol 

definitely been considering outsourcing options because its a big time eater to do it right and if you're going to do something better do it right is what I live by 

also with everything the hype will die out so no need to worry!

replies.author: shlaifu
replies.body:
the hype for what? - games? gen z can't read or sit still long enough to watch a movie. games are the entertainment form of the 21st century.

or AI? - well, not if it can make games. it's going to be the standard way to make them.

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: yes the hype of making games hard to believe but people will quickly realize what it takes to make a good game ai or no ai, low quality or high quality its a lot more than even just making a good game and that will deter a lot of the people that bought into the hype

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: + you still have to be code literate even with ai hell to actually use ai to its fullest potential you have to understand code and basic computer science

replies.author: shlaifu
replies.body: no, no ... large games will become adjustable. like... no real content, because the users will create their own content. like... fortnite without epic having to create content. the modding scene is fully capable of making great stuff, now imagine a whole generation of modders, who now don't need to know anything about the technicalities of gamedev, not getting into modding because they can do everything in fortnite rather than gzdoom

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body: That's super fair actually didn't consider that! I always forget about those game engines and i have seen some crazy stuff come out of there so maybe the future is game engines combed as a game hub/market place? hmmm 🤔
